coverage_assessment: First-pass open-web research only. Five disjoint January windows were explicitly searched, with English and Chinese/Malay/Tamil discovery plus targeted conflict and December/February continuity searches. One five-person January 26 assembly was directly corroborated and excluded below the 50-person threshold. Search logs record actual headers and query times; query/result counts are process records, not proof of coverage. No absence or exhaustiveness claim is made; language, archive and baseline gaps remain.
